entries.760334cd08553bac: An entertainment company that develops and operates the smartphone game app "Memento Mori" and the game dating app "Koiniwa."
entries.79c727dd05955cd4: This is a single-segment business that develops and operates smartphone apps. It is divided into two categories, Games and Other Services, and revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥12,366 million. The company and its consolidated subsidiaries Koiniwa Inc. and Bank of Incubation Inc. handle this business, and the head office is located in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo.
entries.ded555c3bff195cd: This category provides the company's original RPG apps. The flagship “Memento Mori” is an idle RPG featuring characters drawn in a watercolor style; distribution began in October 2022, and cumulative downloads have exceeded 4 million. The apps and content are licensed to other companies as the company's own IP, and royalties are also recorded as revenue. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥11,683 million.
entries.e3ba945c202c9d1e: This is a service other than game apps, developed and operated by consolidated subsidiary Koiniwa Inc. Koiniwa is a game-based romance app with the concept “While I Was Gaming, I Got a Lover.”, launched in April 2021; cumulative downloads have exceeded 3 million. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥682 million.
